column1: # Black/Matrix AD - Chapter 3 departure for Pandemonium / non-diegetic narration
# No manual wrapping: patchline.py supplies pixel-aware line breaks.

column2: Believing that gaining power was the shortest path
to each of their goals, they set out
for the city said to hold armor of immense power:
But whether the true power they sought
was truly a power that this $$世界$$ should desire...
may have been a truth known only to God...
